battle.name: 內沙布兒之戰
battle.brief: 一二二一年四月，蒙古第一次西征平定呼羅珊的最後一役：拖雷率攻城軍抵內沙布兒，圍城清野積砲石，四月初七下令，弩機晝夜齊發，雲梯與火油投射器並進，初九夜牆裂七十餘處，四面登城，肅清四日，只留四千工匠充軍。守軍以三千弩機、五百拋石機守城。卡面歐洲式十字弩與本役器械同代而異地。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 這場戰爭是蒙古帝國第一次西征（一二一九至一二二一年）呼羅珊戰線的收官之戰，發生在一二二一年四月。交戰一方是成吉思汗的大汗國：一二一九年起兵後，蒙古軍在中亞連下撒馬爾罕、布哈拉、玉龍傑赤與花剌子模，一二二〇年再分兵掃蕩殘局——哲別與速不台率輕騎追擊西逃的花剌子模沙阿，脫忽察兒、拔都、察合台分掌北線與西北線，一二二〇年底成吉思汗把呼羅珊劃給第四子拖雷，內沙布兒攻城由拖雷本人統率。蒙古此役的兵力只是西征總兵力（一般估計十萬至二十萬之間）中的一路偏師，但攻城仍帶齊整套攻城器與工匠隊。交戰另一方是花剌子模帝國的呼羅珊當局：花剌子模本城於一二一九年底失守，中央政府瓦解，內沙布兒由城防軍官、教長與地方貴族臨時主持，守軍為哈瓦利吉騎兵、步兵與城防民兵，並從周邊徵集民兵分區據守。雙方指揮系統的成熟度差距極大：蒙古有單一發令者與可持續的後方供應體系，花剌子模一方只有各城各自為戰的臨時防線，沒有可以調動的後備隊。
countriesEn: This battle was the closing action of the Mongol first westward expedition (1219 to 1221) on the Khorasan front, fought in April 1221. One side was the Great Khan's empire of the Mongols: after the war launched in 1219, the Mongol armies took Samarkand, Bukhara, Urgench and Khwarazm in Central Asia during 1220 and then split to mop up what was left — Jebe and Subutai with light cavalry pursued the fleeing Khwarazmian shah, Toq'ochar, Batu and Chagatai took the northern and north-western lines, and at the end of 1220 Genghis Khan allotted Khorasan to his fourth son Tolui, who personally commanded the siege of Nishapur. The Mongol force engaged here was a detachment drawn from a campaign army generally estimated at between one hundred and two hundred thousand, and even this column brought a full train of siege engines and its corps of engineers. The other side was the Khorasan administration of the Khwarazmian Empire: with the capital itself fallen in late 1219 and the central government dissolved, Nishapur was held by a temporary combination of the city garrison commander, the religious establishment and local notables, its defenders drawn from Khwārijā cavalry and foot, city militia and levies gathered from the surrounding district, each holding its own sector of the wall. The gap in command maturity between the two sides was extreme: the Mongols had a single commander and a supply system that kept functioning, while the Khwarazmians had nothing but improvised defences, every city left to its own devices, with no reserves to send forward.
people: 成吉思汗是這場戰爭的最高統帥：西征的發動、追擊沙阿的追蹤命令，以及把呼羅珊交給拖雷的安排，都出自他手；一二二〇年哲別在呼羅珊散發的蒙古文與回鵲文文書，上面蓋的就是他的紅印詔書。拖雷是攻城的主將，先鋒失利後由他率主力抵達，親自清剿城郊山地、收集石料、下令攻城，並在守方乞降許諾歲貢時明確拒絕。脫忽察兒是成吉思汗的女婿與先鋒主將，攻城三日不克時戰死於內沙布兒城下；破城後率萬人入城執行肅清的是成吉思汗之女、脫忽察兒之妻。哲別與速不台在一二二〇年六月已率騎兵追到內沙布兒城下，與呼羅珊當局就供應飼草給養交涉後放棄圍城，續追沙阿——他們的佯敗誘敵戰法是這一戰役的戰術前傳。花剌子模一方留下記錄者包括沙阿穆罕默德二世、呼羅珊宰相抹智兒·木勒克（曾派八人持酒席與禮物議和），以及城破前率教長與士紳出城乞降的大斷事官與城防軍官。
peopleEn: Genghis Khan was the supreme commander: the launch of the expedition, the standing order to pursue the shah, and the decision to hand Khorasan over to Tolui all came from him, and the documents in Uighur and Mongol script that Jebe scattered across Khorasan in 1220 carried the red seal of his own edict. Tolui was the commander of the siege; after his vanguard was checked he brought up the main body, personally cleared the hills around the city, collected stone for the engines, gave the order to assault, and flatly refused when the garrison offered surrender and annual tribute. Toq'ochar, Genghis Khan's son-in-law and the leader of the vanguard, was killed beneath Nishapur when three days of assault brought nothing; the ten thousand men who then went through the city after it fell were led by a daughter of Genghis Khan, Toq'ochar's widow. Jebe and Subutai had already ridden up to Nishapur in June 1220 in pursuit of the shah, negotiated with the Khorasan authorities over fodder and provisions, then abandoned the city and continued the chase — their habit of feigning flight to draw the enemy into a pursuit was the tactical ancestor of this battle. On the Khwarazmian side the record preserves Shah Muhammad II, the Khorasan vizier Muzhir al-Mulk, who sent eight men with wine and gifts to open the talks, and the chief judge of the city, who led the imam and the notables out of the gates to beg for surrender before the wall fell.
kits: 卡面上的兵器是十字弩（Crossbow），歐洲在十一至十二世紀定型的機械張弦弩：上弦由絞盤與牛角擔當，射速交給了機械，單發破甲能力遠勝長弓，代價是裝填慢、射後難以即時追射。同一技術世代的弩在這場戰役裡同時出現在攻守兩方，而且是攻城序列的骨幹。守軍方面，城頭列弩機三千具、拋石機五百具，弩手分據城垛與射孔後，以零散單發封鎖城根通道；拋石機則用於打擊城下的攻城器械與集積的石料。蒙古攻城方配備弩機三千具、拋石機三十具、火焰放射器七百具、雲梯四百架：弩機在近距離壓制城頭射孔、掩護雲梯靠牆，拋石機用收集的碎石打擊牆體，火焰放射器把火油射入城內街巷與守軍集結處，雲梯則在破口打開後供突兵登城。守方另有城頭投石與火盆等常規防禦器械，攻方另有蒙古弓（複合弓）、彎刀、長柄刀與投石索；攻城石料取自城周山地，堆在牆下作砲石，補給靠駱駝隊與牛車。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the crossbow (Crossbow), the mechanically strung bow that reached its European form in the eleventh and twelfth centuries: the tension was taken up by a windlass and a goat's-horn lever, so the rate of fire passed to the machine; a single bolt had far more armour-piercing power than an arrow from a longbow, and the price was slow loading and the inability to shoot again immediately. Crossbows of the same technological generation appear on both sides in this battle, and they form the backbone of the siege order of battle. The defenders had three thousand crossbows and five hundred stone-throwers on the walls, the crossbowmen posted behind crenellations and arrow slits loosing scattered single shots to seal the approaches to the walls, while the throwers were used against the engines and against the stockpiles of stone at the foot of the wall. The Mongol besiegers brought three thousand crossbows, thirty stone-throwers, seven hundred fire-projectors and four hundred siege ladders: the crossbows covered the parapet at close range and shielded the ladders as they came up against the wall, the throwers battered the wall with stone gathered nearby, the fire-projectors shot burning oil into the streets and into the points where the defenders massed, and the ladders carried the storming troops in once the breaches were open. The defenders also had the usual wall defences, stone-throwing and fire-pots, while the attackers carried composite Mongol bows, sabres, long-handled blades and slings; the ammunition stone was quarried from the hills around the city and stacked beneath the walls as shot, and supply ran by camel train and ox cart.
tactics: 蒙古軍的攻城分成四個步驟，節奏清楚得像一套工序。第一步清野：抵達後先掃清內沙布兒四周山地，斷掉守軍可能的外援通道與隱蔽射擊位，同時就地取石。第二步合圍：四面封閉，壕溝水泄不通，並把大量石料運到牆下堆積，讓守方看見圍城已成定局。第三步毀牆：四月初七下令後，弩機晝夜齊發，雲梯與火油投射器同時進逼，壕溝被填平，牆體被轟裂七十餘處。第四步登城：破口一開，四面同時攀入，街巷屋舍都變成戰場，肅清持續四日。守方的戰術是典型的城頭遠程封鎖加援軍期待：用三千具弩機和五百具拋石機覆蓋城根，拖到哈瓦利吉騎兵回援；但四周山地被清空、砲石堆到牆下之後，守軍判定援兵無望，士氣崩潰，於是由大斷事官率教長與士紳出城乞降並許諾歲貢，被拒後仍死守到城破。這一役也說明弩的侷限：弩手在射孔後能壓制接近者，卻無法在破口出現後快速重裝，勝負最終由破牆與破口後的近身戰決定。
tacticsEn: The Mongol siege ran in four clearly separated steps, as regular as a workshop process. First, clearance: on arrival they swept the hills around Nishapur, cutting off any channel of relief and any concealed shooting position, and taking stone from the ground at the same time. Second, encirclement: the city was sealed on all four sides, the ditch was sealed water-tight, and large quantities of stone were carried down and stacked at the foot of the wall so that the defenders could see that the siege was already a fact. Third, breaching: on the seventh of April the order was given, the crossbows kept up their fire day and night without a break, ladders and oil-projectors pressed in at the same time, the ditch was filled, and the wall was cracked in more than seventy places. Fourth, storm: once the breaches opened, the city was entered from all four sides at once, streets and houses became the battlefield, and the sweep continued for four days. The defence was the textbook pattern of wall fire held in the hope of relief: three thousand crossbows and five hundred throwers covering the base of the wall, waiting for the Khwārijā cavalry to come back. Once the hills had been cleared and the stone stacked beneath the wall, the garrison judged that no relief would come, morale broke, and the chief judge went out with the imam and the notables to offer surrender and annual tribute; refused, they held on until the wall fell. The battle also shows the limitation of the crossbow: behind an arrow slit the crossbowman can punish anyone who comes close, but he cannot reload quickly once a breach appears, and the outcome was decided by the destruction of the wall and by the close combat that followed in the breach.
data: 守軍的火力配置可從戰記中逐項核對：城頭弩機三千具、拋石機五百具。蒙古攻城軍則配弩機三千具、拋石機三十具、火焰放射器七百具、雲梯四百架。時間線同樣可以對照：一二二〇年六月初五，哲別與速不台追沙阿至內沙布兒城下，議和未果後離去；一二二〇年冬，拖雷奉命攻呼羅珊，先鋒脫忽察兒連下奈撒、馬魯等城後兵臨內沙布兒，攻城三日不克而戰死，部眾退與主力會合；一二二一年四月初七拖雷下令攻城，初九夜間壕溝已平、牆體新增七十餘處裂口，四面登城，肅清延續約四日，終局留下四千名工匠編入軍伍。全役的攻城階段集中在一二二一年四月，其後數月蒙古軍轉入阿富汗戰線，一二二一年十一月拖雷在那一線病逝。地理上，內沙布兒位於呼羅珊平原東緣，屬今伊朗東北部呼羅珊省，距馬什哈德約七十公里，距木鹿約三百五十公里，距大不里士逾一千公里，正是橫貫波斯高原的門戶。
dataEn: The firepower on the walls can be checked item by item against the chronicles: three thousand crossbows and five hundred stone-throwers for the defenders. The Mongol siege train carried three thousand crossbows, thirty stone-throwers, seven hundred fire-projectors and four hundred siege ladders. The timeline can be matched just as closely: on the fifth of June 1220 Jebe and Subutai brought the shah up to Nishapur and left when the talks failed; in the winter of 1220 Tolui was ordered to take Khorasan, the vanguard under Toq'ochar carried Nesha, Maru and other towns, came up against Nishapur, failed in three days of assault and was killed, and the column withdrew to rejoin the main body; on the seventh of April 1221 Tolui gave the order to assault, by the night of the ninth the ditch had been filled and the wall had opened in more than seventy fresh breaches, the city was entered on all four sides, the sweep ran for about four days, and the only thing systematically kept at the end was four thousand craftsmen enrolled in the army. The assault phase of the whole operation falls inside April 1221; in the months that followed the main force swung into Afghanistan, where Tolui died of illness in November 1221. Geographically, Nishapur lies on the eastern edge of the Khorasan plain, in what is now Khorasan Province in north-eastern Iran, roughly seventy kilometres from Mashhad, about three hundred and fifty kilometres from Merv and more than a thousand kilometres from Tabriz — the gateway across the Iranian plateau.
cause: 遠因是一二一八年的奧特拉爾事件：花剌子模的邊將殺害蒙古商團並扣押使者，成吉思汗於一二一九年以西征為名發動報復性進攻，一年之內掃平中亞的撒馬爾罕、布哈拉、玉龍傑赤與花剌子模。直接原因則是清剿殘餘勢力：一二二〇年六月，成吉思汗命哲別與速不台追擊西逃的沙阿，追兵一路打到呼羅珊，內沙布兒是沙阿東走的最後一站，呼羅珊當局一度同意供給飼草與給養，但追兵仍不放過。一二二〇年底至一二二一年初，成吉思汗把呼羅珊劃給拖雷，拖雷自木鹿方向逐城攻取，先鋒拔除奈撒、馬魯、哈連答兒後直抵內沙布兒。內沙布兒是呼羅珊最後的主要城市，扼住由木鹿通往綠洲腹地與阿富汗的門戶，守住它就等於保住花剌子模在呼羅珊的地位；而對蒙古來說，攻下它才能把征服從要道掃成全面控制。器械層面上，弩在十三世紀初已是歐亞最普及的攻城與守城器械，蒙古把它成建制帶進攻城序列。
causeEn: The distant cause was the affair of Otrar in 1218: Khwarazmian border commanders killed a Mongol merchant caravan and detained an envoy, and in 1219 Genghis Khan launched a war of revenge that within a year swept Samarkand, Bukhara, Urgench and Khwarazm in Central Asia. The immediate cause was the mopping-up of what remained: in June 1220 Genghis Khan ordered Jebe and Subutai to pursue the shah as he fled eastward, and the pursuit ran through Khorasan, Nishapur being the last stop on the shah's road east; the Khorasan authorities at one point agreed to supply fodder and provisions, but the pursuers would not let go. Between the end of 1220 and the beginning of 1221 Genghis Khan allotted Khorasan to Tolui, who advanced from the direction of Merv and took town after town, and once the vanguard had removed Nesha, Maru and Kaladanch he came straight down on Nishapur. Nishapur was the last great city of Khorasan and it held the door that leads from Merv into the oasis interior and on toward Afghanistan; to hold it was to hold the position of Khwarazm in Khorasan, and for the Mongols to take it was to turn a conquest of roads into a conquest of the whole region. At the level of equipment, the crossbow was by the early thirteenth century one of the most widespread siege and defence weapons in Eurasia, and the Mongols brought it into their siege order in formed units.
impact: 內沙布兒陷落後，呼羅珊的主要城邑已全部易手，花剌子模帝國在東翼的抵抗中樞被拔除，蒙古的統治從要道包圍網推向綠洲與鄉村，一二二一年秋主力即轉入阿富汗戰線，尋找札蘭丁。對蒙古軍本身，此役最實際的收穫是工匠：城中約四千名工匠被成批保留並編入軍伍，成為攻城器、冶金與後勤體系的骨幹；此後在阿富汗、伊拉克、西亞與東歐的攻城戰，蒙古都沿用同一套保留工匠的制度，攻城器的水準因此一路提高。技術上，此役提供了一個反面教材：當進攻方同時投入大量弩機、拋石機、火油投射器並先清空城郊山地時，靠城頭火力與援軍期望維持的防線往往在數日內崩潰。中長線看，花剌子模的殘餘勢力退入阿富汗與南亞，隨軍而行的波斯工匠與射手把歐亞的攻城與騎射技術帶到德里蘇丹國，日後又隨蒙古在阿富汗與印度的戰役反向流動。
impactEn: With Nishapur fallen, every major town of Khorasan had changed hands and the central point of Khwarazmian resistance in the east had been removed; Mongol rule moved from a network of roads into the oasis towns and the countryside, and in the autumn of 1221 the main body turned into Afghanistan in search of Jalal al-Din. For the Mongol army itself the most solid prize of the battle was the craftsmen: some four thousand of them were kept in a body and enrolled in the army, forming the backbone of the siege-engine, metallurgy and logistics system; the same practice of keeping craftsmen alive was followed in the sieges that followed in Afghanistan, Iraq, the Levant and eastern Europe, and the standard of the Mongol siege train rose accordingly. Technologically the battle supplies an instructive reversal: when the attacker commits large numbers of crossbows, stone-throwers and oil-projectors at once and first clears the hills outside the town, a defence based on wall fire and on the expectation of relief tends to collapse within days. In the longer run the remaining Khwarazmian forces fell back into Afghanistan and South Asia, and the Persian craftsmen and archers who travelled with them carried Eurasian siegecraft and mounted archery into the Delhi Sultanate, only to flow back the other way with the Mongols in the campaigns in Afghanistan and India.
result: 內沙布兒在一二二一年四月九日夜至十日之間陷落：壕溝被填平，牆體在弩機與拋石機的連續打擊下裂出七十餘處缺口，蒙古軍自四面同時攀入城中。破城之後是長達四日的肅清，蒙古軍逐街逐巷搜索，見守軍即殺，戰事一直延續到城內主要街區逐一被清完；執行這一任務的是成吉思汗之女、已陣亡的先鋒主將脫忽察兒之妻，她率領的萬人入城之後不留餘地。城內的主要頭目在城破時失散或陣亡，記錄未詳，大斷事官的乞降也未能換得任何條件。蒙古軍最終只保留四千名工匠，將其編入軍伍隨軍作戰，其餘一切城防與抵抗力量隨城陷落而解體。對蒙古而言，呼羅珊就此平定；對花剌子模帝國而言，這場戰役是它最後一場大規模守城戰，此後其殘餘只在阿富汗與印度以小規模的形式存在，直到札蘭丁在一二二六年於安達盧斯被殺，帝國的名號才真正終結。
resultEn: Nishapur fell between the ninth and tenth of April 1221: the ditch was filled, the wall was opened in more than seventy places by the concentrated fire of the crossbows and the throwers, and the Mongols climbed in simultaneously from all four sides. What followed was a sweep lasting four days, the army working street by street and house by house, killing soldiers it found, and the business of the city was not finished until the main quarters had been cleared in turn; this work was carried out by a daughter of Genghis Khan, the widow of the fallen vanguard commander Toq'ochar, who entered the city with ten thousand men and left nothing standing. The principal leaders of the town were scattered or killed in the breach, and the details are not recorded; the chief judge's plea for terms bought nothing in the end. The Mongols kept four thousand craftsmen, enrolled them in the army and took them on campaign, and every other element of the city's defence dissolved with the city. For the Mongols, Khorasan was settled. For the Khwarazmian Empire this was the last large-scale defence of a city, and what was left of it survived afterwards only in small bands in Afghanistan and India, until Jalal al-Din was killed at Andelus in 1226 and the name of the empire truly ended.
